# OfficeDev OneNote sample

`OneWithFileData.one` was vendored by the `onenote.rs` project from the OfficeDev/Interop-TestSuites test data. The included `LICENSE` preserves OfficeDev's MIT notice. The upstream vendoring commit is `de3a64e8159c684b137ded89c3fef3c17272ec1d`; the original OfficeDev commit was not recorded in the vendoring metadata.

The sample bytes are unchanged. `SHA256SUMS.txt` records the file hash. No OfficeDev or parser code is included.

Sources:

- [OfficeDev/Interop-TestSuites](https://github.com/OfficeDev/Interop-TestSuites)
- [onenote.rs source revision](https://github.com/msiemens/onenote.rs/tree/de3a64e8159c684b137ded89c3fef3c17272ec1d)
